Four objects are moving.
Which object has a zero resultant force acting on it?
A
the object moving at a decreasing speed
B
the object moving at an increasing speed
C
the object moving at a constant speed in a circle
D
the object moving at a constant speed in a straight line

options.label: A
options.text: the object moving at a decreasing speed

options.label: B
options.text: the object moving at an increasing speed

options.label: C
options.text: the object moving at a constant speed in a circle

options.label: D
options.text: the object moving at a constant speed in a straight line
